speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two naves, and a plain chest between the light and me. I know the distance. I am not making it a longer stay because the light is going.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The blank at home is mine. I did not come here to be handed a line by a stone. Back across the same yards.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is on the board. This is not where it gets a seal.
